summary: Frontend-only regression for iteration 28: Store lookbook + collection cards, ParallaxBand on Invest/Support, and new editorial bands on Framework/Ecosystem. Tested at 1440px and 390px viewports. All new testids visible; all images load (naturalWidth > 0 once in viewport - collection cards use loading='lazy'). No horizontal overflow on any tested page. No console errors. Waitlist form on /store still submits successfully to 'You're on the list.' state.
critical_code_review_comments: Collection card uses loading='lazy'. Automated naturalWidth checks must scroll the element into view before asserting - this is expected behavior, not a defect.
seed_data_creation: Waitlist entry submitted for test_qa_2026@example.com (name: QA Tester) on /store during flow verification.
